articles.title: Letter: The Playground Upgrade on Canton Terrace Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I have lived on Canton Terrace for 18 years, and I want to say what a difference the Stonebridge Trail Crew has made. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. Please keep the playground upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Canton Terrace use it every week.
